# KayaTo landing page images

Place the final images in this folder using these filenames:

- `hero/hero-dashboard.webp` - main product image, recommended 1600 x 980
- `team-at-work.webp` - team or lifestyle image, recommended 900 x 1050
- `workspace-overview.webp` - second product image, recommended 1600 x 960
- `final-cta-team.webp` - final call-to-action image, recommended 900 x 700

WebP is recommended for smaller page weight. Keep each large image below 350 KB when possible.
